top_signals.title: Strive adds 1,355 bitcoin, picks up pace toward year-end second-place treasury goal
top_signals.summary: Strive (ASST) remains the fifth-largest public bitcoin holder, behind Strategy, Twenty One, Metaplanet and MARA.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chancellor announces Bank of England appointments
top_signals.summary: His Majesty the King and the Chancellor have appointed three new non-executive directors to the Bank of England’s Court of Directors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Former South Korean military officers sentenced to prison over 2024 martial law incident
top_signals.summary: Then-South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in 2024, ordering military forces to the National Assembly in an failed self-coup.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Air Force has a $14 billion supply hole, service officials say
top_signals.summary: As the force grapples with supply chain and maintenance issues, sustainment funding to fill the $14 billion gap is becoming increasingly necessary.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: This Is a Healthy Environment for Deals, Rizzieri Says
top_signals.summary: Jerry Rizzieri, Mizuho Securities USA president and CEO, says we're in a healthy environment for dealmaking. He also speaks about where investment opportunities are in Japan on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: China confirms Xi’s first trip to U.S. in nearly three years
top_signals.summary: The visit to Washington comes as a one-year trade truce winds down.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
